name: mechanism 2: same year, both naming their season, refused on the season

source.test: mechanism 2: same year, both naming their season, refused on the season

why: Season 2 and season 3 of one show are two broadcast runs. On titles alone "Mushoku Tensei Season 2" and "Mushoku Tensei Season 3" score 0.9175, above the 0.9 threshold, and the two dates are 28 days apart so no date rule can separate them either. The ordinals disagree, and that is the only thing in the data that says these are different runs.
